summary: Arrow Financial Corporation filed an 8-K covering Items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01 to disclose quarterly earnings results, an investor presentation, and a regular quarterly dividend declaration of $0.30 per share. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is present. The filing is a routine earnings release with a standard dividend announcement, containing no special-situation corporate event.
